name: Damas
summary: Branding studio site in deep bottle green with a pale noise-textured hero, Anton condensed caps headlines, a yellow brush-stroke accent and tilted, stacked photo cards of motion-blurred imagery.

fonts.pairing: Anton 400 condensed caps and title case at -0.02em, tight 1.0 to 1.1 leading, over Satoshi 500 body with a script (Damion) only for a tiny quote signature

signature: two photo cards tilted a few degrees and overlapped at the hero's right with a yellow lightning brush mark between type and image
pale rounded panels inset 20px into the green page so light and dark sections alternate like sheets on a desk
project list where the first two cases are big split rows with mini thumbnail strips and the rest collapse into ruled rows of name, date, discipline and a small rounded thumb
imagery: motion-blurred, desaturated editorial photography with warm orange light leaks; rounded 20px corners with a thin pale outline
layout_grid: 1280 canvas, about 1200 content, 120px section padding on green, 20px inset frames around light panels, 20 to 25px card radii
